decision: scoped port: components, common, modules/hotkeys, examples, modals, page chrome, kitchen sink playground. skipped Next routes, llm docs, CLI/Python Simulacrum, vendored node helpers
why: they are React-site or Node concerns, not the UI library

decision: solid-js 1.9 + vite-plugin-solid for dev/test, rolldown-plugin-solid inside the pack block for the library build
why: vp pack alone left raw JSX in dist; the rolldown plugin compiled it
result: Button test passes, pack output compiled

decision: dropped unused helpers from common/utilities and constants, skipped queries.ts
why: grep showed nothing in components or the kitchen sink calls them

decision: hotkeys ported as createHotkeys on a single context, dropped the ref-scoped binding
why: no caller passes a ref; the old API returned a ref callback that nobody used

decision: ModalState stores a render closure instead of component plus props
why: keeps ModalContext typed without any

decision: 7 parallel delegates (a1 a2 b c d e1 e2) each own disjoint files, all read one recipe
why: components are independent once paths and exports are fixed up front

decision: added tests/conventions.test.ts that greps src for React leftovers, camelCase style keys, numeric px styles
why: these are the silent Solid breakages (ignored keys, missing auto px) so a script catches them instead of review

decision: built playwright parity harness: fake clock paused before load, seeded Math.random, per accordion slices plus canonical DOM compare, pixelmatch threshold 0
why: need a zero-diff gate and a way to point at which component differs

decision: ran baseline twice against the React build
why: a flaky harness would make later diffs meaningless

decision: widened ActionButton hotkey to JSX.Element, kept isEmpty guard
why: React original accepts any node; isEmpty treats an object as empty so a BlockLoader hotkey never renders there either

decision: 7 delegates plus 5 page-section delegates returned; whole tree typechecked clean
why: gate before running parity
evidence: vp check: 0 errors, vp test: 172 pass

decision: waited for React hydration before clicking, kept the fake clock paused during the wait
why: a click before hydration was silently dropped, which made the baseline flaky

decision: reseed Math.random after mount and before the first clock advance
why: React and Solid consume different counts of random numbers while mounting, DataTable ticks then diverged

decision: canonical DOM dump drops empty class attrs, value/checked attrs, textarea text nodes, id refs, rounds svg path numbers
why: these differ in serialization only: React omits empty rules from CSS modules, Node computed the SSR svg floats

decision: replaced Solid Portal with BodyPortal
why: Portal wraps content in a div React does not render; DOM differed in every dropdown scenario

decision: SPACE identifier for literal spaces in DropdownMenu footer and ModalError
why: Solid merges {" "} into neighbor text, React keeps a separate node; menu width differed by 1/64 px and 21 px of text moved

decision: ActionButton hotkey typed string|number, dropped the BlockLoader hotkey from the playground
why: React isEmpty treats an element as empty, so the loader never rendered; typing it honestly removes a dead prop
result: pixels unchanged, reported as a React-side bug

decision: baseline capture repeats a scenario until two runs agree, unstable ones are marked INCONCLUSIVE
why: the React baseline loses its modal and action bar on roughly 1 in 10 runs, not a Solid issue

decision: comment review run, deleted restating comments, kept porting whys and framework gotchas
why: comment-sicko flagged 30, many were verbatim ports or CSS copied for parity

decision: harness advances the fake clock in 16ms steps with a real yield, 2ms for DOM snake and matrix modes
why: React runs effects in a later task, so one long jump let Solid reschedule intervals that React rescheduled late; DOM snake head sat one cell apart

decision: full parity run against the stable React baseline
why: final acceptance on the real artifact
result: 81 of 82 scenarios pixel diff 0 and DOM equal; matrix-modes INCONCLUSIVE because the React baseline disagrees with itself

decision: final full parity run, supersedes the earlier 81 of 82 row
why: reviewer found the earlier row and check.log out of date, and unstable.txt overwritten by filtered runs; fixed the merge and reran
result: 81 of 81 decided scenarios pixel diff 0 and DOM equal; 1 INCONCLUSIVE (matrix-modes, React baseline disagrees with itself)

decision: added content-language and shortcut icon tags to the playground index pages
why: reviewer noted DefaultMetaTags tags were dropped and the harness only dumps body

decision: pinned the React commit in react-sync.json at b952df1
why: the React tree was clean at that commit when the port was built and verified

decision: restored every stylesheet from React and excluded src css from the formatter
why: an earlier vp fmt run rewrote 24 stylesheets, so three-way merges would conflict on quotes and whitespace
result: byte-identical, test fails on any drift

decision: wrote scripts/react-sync.ts (status, plan, apply, prepare, mark) and a path classifier with a test
why: the mechanical half of a sync (merge css, list what to port, build the React baseline, gate the pin) should be a script, not prose

decision: tried apply on a scratch copy with the pin moved 6 commits back, then to before 2.0.0
why: to see merges stay clean and write the same bytes the port already has
evidence: scratch run, diff -r of src after apply

decision: mark refuses without a prepared build of that sha, a clean full-run check.log newer than every source change
why: so a partial or stale parity run cannot move the pin

decision: moved the port recipe into skills/sync-from-react/references and added the traps the first port hit
why: the sync skill delegates by the same recipe; one copy

decision: ran prepare, baseline, check, mark end to end at the pinned sha
why: prove the skill's commands work on the real artifact, and that restored stylesheets keep parity
result: 79 of 79 decided identical, 3 inconclusive (baseline never self-stable), mark accepted

decision: correction: mark took the no-changes shortcut at the same sha, the clean-parity gate itself was only exercised on the scratch copy
why: the row above overstated what mark checked
result: gate path verified by hand earlier

decision: publish straight from a push to main: version, commit, publish, tag in one job, not a Version Packages PR
why: request was every push publishes pending changesets; the PR flow adds a merge step

decision: script publishes even with no changeset unless the version is 0.0.0; version commit lands before publish
why: publish skips versions already on npm so a failed publish heals on the next run; 0.0.0 stops a first push from releasing a never-released package
evidence: relsim run: failing token run then healing run, rerun no-op, 0.0.0 guard

decision: switched to npm trusted publishing: id-token permission, no NPM_TOKEN, NPM_CONFIG_PROVENANCE, repository field set to sammccord/sacred-solid
why: request was provenance instead of tokens; provenance checks package.json repository against the running repo
result: workflow only exercised on a local registry, OIDC itself untested

decision: added an npm >= 11.5.1 guard before the version commit; tag push limited to tags on HEAD; pushes skip hooks
why: reviewer findings: old npm cannot do OIDC and would fail after the bump; git push --tags can fail on stale remote tags
result: bump, publish, tag and rerun no-op verified locally
